title: Memory Save
statement: Implement `solve(amount)`. Return `saved` when `amount` is a positive int. Return `error` otherwise. This is the fake repository's save rule.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A fake that accepts a zero amount is softer than the database constraint and will hide a bug.

editorial: A fake that accepts a zero amount is softer than the database constraint and will hide a bug. The memory store rejects non-positive amounts the same way the real one does. The string is the outcome of that one save.
